profile.summary:
Computer/Systems Engineer

ITIL Foundation Certified

Dissertation at the University de Concepción - Chile. Second half of 1998: “Operations for the Constraint Centered Entity Relationships Model”.

Architecture specialist: .NET, Cliente Servidor, Web Services, Windows Services, J2EE
Methodology: ITIL, Fagan, Walk Through, CMM 
Programming language sand Framework: C / C++ / C# / VB.NET / Java / J2EE / Python / .NET / MVC / ASP.NET / Entity Framework / Structured Query Language (SQL) / Tuxedo and Oracle / Fagan inspection / CMMi methodology (Capability Maturity Model Integration)
